name: adv_advanced_clean
title: Four advanced training patterns, all correct: QAT + export, uncertainty-weighted multi-task, a legitimate curriculum re-split, and knowledge distillation
origin: written for the domain-generative-rl-graph hardening round, 2026-09-13
note: A four-file false-positive battery. Each file is one shape a rule is most likely to get wrong: QAT calls model.eval() mid-script on purpose; the multi-task loss is three terms summed in a helper; the curriculum re-splits a growing labelled pool every round, which is legitimate; and distillation pairs log_softmax with softmax inside a KL divergence, which is correct. Any finding on any of these four files is a false positive.
